title: Paul Hellyer: dying Canadian emergency management head sat inside a craft at Area 51
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Paul Hellyer: dying Canadian emergency management head sat inside a craft at Area 51, about unspecified at Nevada test site and Area 51, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Bradford, Ontario; Langley, Virginia; Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: go wrong. And he said, "I got taken to Washington to Langley. I signed my life away and then they took me to Area 51 and I sat inside a craft."

plain: A researcher, Grant Cameron, told the podcast host Jesse Michels a story he credits to a man named Paul Hellyer, about a dying man who had headed emergency management in Canada. According to the story, this man said he was taken to Langley, Virginia, home of the CIA, the US spy agency, where he "signed my life away," and was then flown to Area 51, a secret US military base in Nevada, where he sat inside a craft. If true, it would mean the US holds a flying craft that someone from Canada's government was allowed to see.
